scope: Standalone Rust application implementing the Go CLI and TUI with corrected shared behavior
rendering_contract: Same controls, information, themes and Unicode editing; renderer layout and Markdown whitespace may differ

groups.name: Display and configuration
features: responsive picker overlays and history panes
complete bounded help and wrapped diff scrolling
active theme indicator, due-filter explanations and picker positions
checks: tui command registry matches Go source

groups.name: Recent files
features: save cursor for actual active file
case-insensitive substring search preserving frecency order
home abbreviation, Unicode-safe filename visibility and access counts

groups.name: History and recovery
features: idle external reload and input deferral

groups.name: Native persistence
features: file sync and Unix directory sync
read-only ephemeral edits and explicit save

bug_corrections: Go theme saves preserve versioning and unfamiliar configuration keys
Append creates a root task at document end rather than entering the last nested list
Sorting moves sibling subtrees instead of reassigning flat labels
Deleting a parent promotes every nested child list
Moving a parent into its descendant fails without mutation
Insertion returns the new sibling index after the selected subtree
Structural serialization preserves the order and ownership of task paragraphs and lists
Unknown frontmatter keys do not disable recognized settings
Explicit flags override file settings; CLI honors file read-only settings
Recent-file switches reset per-file settings and persist the active file cursor
Scripted control keys and modal Escape use the interactive state machine
Invalid indent and unchanged move gestures do not consume undo
Fuzzy matching uses whole Unicode characters
Version browsing and unsaved read-only edits defer automatic reload
Clipboard backends cover macOS, Windows, Wayland and X11
Rust Windows console input decodes key-down UTF-16 separately from release records, preserving emoji and bracketed paste
performance_gate: All document/application/history/terminal checks must pass; publish native evidence separately and retain any unverified platform explicitly
